summary.text: NOVA RENHOLD AS is a private limited company registered in Skjetten, founded 2016-08-31. NOVA RENHOLD AS provides services within cleaning, rengjøring (cleaning) and transport services. It was previously named G&I RENHOLD AS until 2026-10-10. Its main industry code is 81.210: general cleaning of buildings. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 2 653 268 NOK and the annual result was 136 274 NOK; operating income was up from 2 472 674 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 293 824 NOK in 2024 to 136 274 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 325 206 NOK in 2024 to 461 480 NOK in 2025. Registered leadership: Ilona Zeimyte (daglig leder and styrets leder). The registered employee count went from 8 on 2025-11-12 to 9 on 2026-10-14. Recent changes in the register: name set to NOVA RENHOLD AS on 2026-10-10.
